annotations.annotation_text: The Finn's shop in Manhattan: a subterranean archive of obsolete electronics, cathode ray tubes, and discarded cybernetic components representing the material archaeological strata of technological obsolescence.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 51.

annotations.target_phrase: the guts of a television so old it was studded with the glass stumps of vacuum tubes
annotations.annotation_text: The tactile debris of mid-20th-century media technology rotting in the backrooms of the Sprawl, contrasting the physical antiquity of hardware with the pure mathematical light of cyberspace.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 51.
